originality.rationale: The three primary same-channel papers provide pair-intersection results or redundancy constructions, not exact N=5 maxima through n=9; indexed results about disjoint-ball correction do not imply relaxed five-read capacities. The actual comparison covers structural equivalences, broad coverage, exact tables and logical implication; residual unindexed-table risk is disclosed.
residual_risks: Unindexed prior exact finite capacity computations could exist.
Full text of every potentially relevant peripheral paper was not exhaustively searched; reported source inspections state their actual coverage.

value.rationale: Five-read mixed-error reconstruction code capacity is the intrinsic natural extremal invariant in the 2026 study. Seven sharp starting values, including a nontrivial 512-vertex optimum and the first nonmonotonic blocklength transition, provide reproducible exact benchmarks for short-read system design; no general theorem is claimed.
